}}'''Kumira Dhoran''' was a [[Shienaran]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].

== Appearance and Personality==
Kumira was a handsome with blue eyes, graceful hands and short dark brown hair. She was 5'5" tall. She preferred strong woolens over silk, but would sometimes wear a silk scarf. She sometimes gets ink stains on her clothes, but she would deal with them as soon as she could.

Like many of the Brown Ajah, Kumira could become easily absorbed in her studies, sometimes to the exclusion of the world around her. She had a reputation of aggressively pursuing those things of which she had taken an interest.{{ref/book|9|23}}  

Unlike most Browns, she is also hard-headed, practical, observant and very strong-willed. She is interested in everything and doesn't like wasting time. 

She was not afraid to swear, sometimes using the word "peace" as if it were an oath. She takes care not to offend anyone on purpose, even those of a lower status than hers; in fact, she is often more considerate of those with lower status, such as when she debates with Daigian over logic. 

==Strength and Abilities==
Kumira is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|30}}. She would not be able to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

Kumira had a eidetic memory.

== History ==
Kumira was born in {{ne|886}}. She came from a well-to-do farm family, although her father was a soldier who retired due to his wounds. She had soldiers on both sides of her family.

She went to the Tower in {{ne|902}} at the age of sixteen. After spending seven years as Novice and nine as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|918}}. 

She did not have a Warder.

== Activities ==
[[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] brought Kumira and [[Daigian]] to the [[Sun Palace]] so that that she could memorize every detail of the goings on among the captured Aes Sedai so that it could be analyzed later. 

Some time later Kumira [[Traveling|Traveled]] with Cadsuane to [[Far Madding]] to track down [[Rand al'Thor]].  Among the group of sisters Cadsuane had gathered around her, which included some captured at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] and sworn to obey the Dragon Reborn, Kumira stood almost at the bottom in terms of the usual hierarchy.

During the [[Battle near Shadar Logoth]], Kumira linked with [[Shalon din Togara Morning Tide]] and [[Verin Mathwin]] to patrol the area around [[Shadar Logoth]]. They encountered [[Graendal]] and Kumira was killed in driving her off.
